Chapter 6455: Father And Son

Chapter 6455: Father And Son

“If you think I want you to go to Heavenrealm, then do it, it’s not a bad place anyway.” Li Qiye said.

“Nothing is good in that damned place.” The man said.

“There is always good in any world, it’s just that you’re nothing good.” Li Qiye said.

“I say the same to you.” He glared.

“Maybe, but am I not here to check on you, I don’t want to see you die in this dream.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Would you be here if I had no value left?” He argued.

“This type of conjecture is unnecessary since I’m here and no one else is.” Li Qiye said.

“Hmph, a cat crying for a mouse.” He said coldly.

“Are we ready to leave yet?” Li Qiye said.

“Fine, I’ve been here long enough. Looks like I don’t have a choice anyway.” He said before disappearing into the ground.

“How are you two related?” The skull asked Li Qiye.

“Just acquaintances.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Haha, looks more like father and son to me.” The skull laughed.

“Are you that bored? Go dig something.” Li Qiye said.

“What am I going to dig with this body?” The skull said.

“You made this spring so you know it best.” Li Qiye said.

“I’m too fragile for that now, can’t make it down there.” The skull became irate.

“Don’t worry, I’m here.” Li Qiye smiled and tapped the skull, channeling primordial light into it.

“Bam!” He then smashed it into the ground.

“Fuck, this isn’t over!” The skull’s voice trailed and disappeared as it was being sent to the spring.

Li Qiye then looked around the dirty room and said: “How depressing.”

He took out a chair and placed it near the window, sitting down and basking in the sunlight.

“Old man, returning to life, albeit not as yourself, still feels good.” He murmured: “Just being alive is good.”

He sighed and closed his eyes, enjoying a short rest.

“Buzz.” After who knows how long, golden light gushed out of the room and illuminated the sky for a second before disappearing.

It still alerted many cultivators and natives. Those near the house immediately rushed over, thinking it might be a gold mine.

Taking in one might be enough to conjure a golden tree, resulting in numerous possibilities.

“Did you see where the light came from just now?” Many barged in and saw Li Qiye inside.

He didn’t move an inch, seemingly not hearing them.

“There’s no gold here.” A few cultivators activated their divine intent and heavenly gaze to scan the room.

“That’s not right, the light definitely came from here. There might be a hidden mine.” One didn’t give up.

Gold was irresistible for cultivators and natives. Some willingly risked their lives.

“Brat, we’re talking to you! Did the light come from here?!” Another shouted at Li Qiye and garnered the same response, or lack thereof.

“Hmph, this brat.” The guy scowled.

“Destroy this house and excavate deep, the mine might be down here.” An expert suggested.

“Leave if you want to live, don’t do something so foolish.” Li Qiye opened his eyes and spoke without looking at them.

“How bold, you must be tired of living!” The expert shouted.

However, a few maintained their composure. One of them asked: “Did you see the golden light earlier?”

“Yes.” He smiled.

“Was it from the ground?” The cultivator asked calmly.

“That’s right.” He said.

Everyone became excited upon hearing this.

“There’s a mine for sure.” The cultivator said.

“Then let’s excavate this whole place.” Some became impatient.

“No, a mine would have been found long ago by the three kings or other cultivators.” One person disagreed.

“Right, the town had been swept through numerous times before.” Many agreed.

“This is no mine, it is the very source of Gold Village.” Li Qiye said.

“Really?” The crowd listened attentively.

“No way, there would be golden trees and supreme lords here already.” Someone said.

“He’s talking nonsense, don’t believe him.” The majority looked down on Li Qiye’s cultivation.

“That’s fine.” Li Qiye smiled.

“The source is truly down there?” A pleasant voice stole everyone’s attention.

A girl walked out of the group, possessing the aura of a ruler. The notion of it being “lonely at the top” came to mind.

She was young and gorgeous like a blossoming flower. She was born endowed with an air of nobility.

Her eyes were bright but there was a hint of melancholy between her brows. She seemed to be far away from home and longed for it.

“Monarch Dugu.” Many lowered their head since she was one of the three kings of this town named Octagon.

She came from the prestigious Dugu Clan in the real world, a power not inferior to Trinity or Seventy-two Skyraiser Sect.

Rumor has it she was a blood descendant of Dugu Yuan, the clan’s patriarch.

“My name is Dugu Qing, may I ask for your name?” She bowed, able to see something special about Li Qiye. Of course, she couldn’t pinpoint it to anything specific.
